system.description:
Replaces your Dexterity modifier with a flat +4 for Reflex Defense.

Damage Reduction 2 (does not apply against lightsabers). Reduces speed by 5 feet and imposes a -2 Armor Check Penalty to Acrobatics, Athletics, Endurance, Initiative and Stealth. Has 1 Upgrade Point. Without Armor Proficiency you gain none of this armor's benefits; its penalties still apply.

Beskar'gam Upgrade (Mandalorians only): Damage Reduction 5.
